name: disk-scanner
description: Windows disk space scanner and analyzer: folder sizes, file-type breakdown, largest files. By wdfdsyhb.

description_i18n.en: Local-first Windows disk space analyzer: folder size ranking, file-type breakdown, largest-files list, and confirmation-gated safe cleanup. Read-only by default; no network.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 本地优先的 Windows 磁盘空间分析：目录体积排行、文件类型分布、最大文件清单，以及需确认的安全清理。默认只读，无网络访问。
